verdict.rationale: The README documents an in-agent marketplace install: `/plugin marketplace add Jakeschincariol/replica-skill` followed by `/plugin install replica-skill@replica-skill`, plus project-local copy into `.claude/skills/` as an alternative. Nothing confirms the skills are active in the next session, and the evidence is vendor-claimed docs only. missing for 10: evidence that the collection is active in the next session after install, a single-step install (it takes two commands), independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
